data_route: dsImaging admission of image_root asset plus per-image metadata declaring pathology label, label levels and patient privacy unit; three DSLite custodians.

evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean and sample SD across three seeds
evaluation.alternative: None predeclared: this task specifies one cohort and one contract, with no named fallback. Report any epsilon-8 diagnostic failure without a post-score configuration change.
evaluation.central_schedule: Five rounds of one local epoch, batch 32, SGD 0.001, same initial head, patient-mean frozen features and patient-modal label, pooled Poisson sampling, expected batch divisor; no clipping or noise. Reuse this central fit across epsilon values for a seed.
evaluation.diagnostic: AUC > 0.5 and accuracy > held-out majority-class rate; report per-replicate and three-seed mean comparison.
evaluation.pooled_dp: Run unchanged released _dp_fit on the 852 pooled patient records, with the same five-round schedule and epsilon/delta/clip as federation.
evaluation.test_policy: Do not inspect held-out labels/images or score models before settings are fixed. One scoring pass for each trained replicate; never change a scored configuration.
twins: identical frozen backbone and head, same split and schedule, centrally without DP

instrumentation: Public-only observer copies of the segmentation/sequence harness: seed/capture analyst initialization; observe node accountant inputs/steps and public tensor hashes after the mandatory runner integrity gate. No replacement of training, privacy calibration, clipping or sampling.

model.bounds_policy: Released image transform and fixed feature totalization; no data-derived feature bounds.
model.head: linear 512 to 2; cross_entropy

model_params_policy: Unchanged v0.5.0 registry defaults; no schedule search.
patient_training: Released runner averages frozen features within patient and takes deterministic modal label before patient DP-SGD. Source pathology labels are consistent within patient according to archived audit.
randomness: Seed controls patient split and analyst-side public initial head. DP noise/sampling use unchanged node-owned sticky cryptographic randomness. Node secrets are not published; seed alone cannot reconstruct them.

release.change_scope: Server import guard only; canonical runner and all training, sampling, clipping and privacy settings unchanged.

split.policy: Reuse byte-identical segmentation split JSON for each seed; split-v1 SHA256 patient ordering, first floor(n/5) patients held out, sites-v1 hash ordering dealt across three sites.
split.split_source: Recreated by the unchanged segmentation prepare_busbra/split_subjects functions; require byte-identical archived hashes before execution.

diagnosis.central_solver: scipy L-BFGS-B; tol=1e-9; maxiter=10000; intercept unpenalized
diagnosis.selection_rule: Prune to top two by patient inner-validation nonprivate site-step-matched AUC; choose highest actual federated-DP patient inner-validation AUC at epsilon 8; ties candidate id ascending.
